nodes.name: Substrate Cleaning
nodes.procedure: A piece of NiFe foam (Ni/Fe = 1:1, 1.5 mm thickness) was first cleaned with 3 M hydrochloric acid, water, and acetone, respectively, for 15 min.
nodes.source_text: A piece of NiFe foam ... respectively, for 15 min.

nodes.name: Etching Solution Preparation
nodes.procedure: Ethylene glycol (98 mL), water (2 mL), and H2SO4 (20 g) were added into the beaker to form a homogeneous solution (A).
nodes.source_text: To prepare the reaction solution, ethylene glycol (98 mL), water (2 mL), and H2SO4 (20 g) were added into the beaker to form a homogeneous solution (A).

nodes.name: Acid-Corrosion and Autologous Growth
nodes.procedure: The cleaned NiFe foam was immersed in the homogeneous solution A (98 mL ethylene glycol, 2 mL water, 20 g H2SO4) for 10 h. Then, the acid-etched NiFe foam was washed with water and then dried overnight in air to allow for the oxidative coprecipitation of Fe(III) and Ni(II) into NiFe LDH nanosheet arrays.

unit_operations.name: Immersion
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Then, the cleaned NiFe foam was immersed in the A solution with different reaction times.

unit_operations.name: Washing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: the acid-etched NiFe foam was washed with water

unit_operations.name: Drying and Coprecipitation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: then dried overnight to obtain hollow NiFe LDH@NiFe... partial Fe(II) is gradually oxidized into Fe(III) under air ambiance during drying... generated Fe3+, Ni2+, and OH- are coprecipitated on the surface of the NiFe foam

nodes.source_text: Then, the cleaned NiFe foam was immersed in the A solution with different reaction times. Finally, the acid-etched NiFe foam was washed with water and then dried overnight to obtain hollow NiFe LDH@NiFe. ... partial Fe(II) is gradually oxidized into Fe(III) under air ambiance during drying. Meanwhile, oxygen is reduced to hydroxides... generated Fe3+, Ni2+, and OH- are coprecipitated on the surface of the NiFe foam

nodes.name: Nickel Foam Cleaning
nodes.procedure: A piece of nickel foam was cleaned using the same preparation method as the NiFe foam, involving 3 M HCl, water, and acetone for 15 min each.
nodes.source_text: a piece of nickel foam was processed with the same preparation method.

nodes.name: Nickel Foam Etching
nodes.procedure: The cleaned nickel foam was immersed in the solution A (ethylene glycol/water/H2SO4) for 10 h, then washed with water and dried overnight in air, following the same procedure as NiFe LDH@NiFe to obtain Ni-OH@Ni.
